answer: Each agent identity must lock a fixed stake bond and present a hardware-attested key, and the ledger allows one bond per verified device. To fake a vote you therefore pay a full bond and control a real attested machine; ten thousand sybils cost ten thousand bonds and ten thousand devices. A crystal-clear slashing rule then punishes coordination: siblings voting in the same timing pulse or mirroring a willow-like referral tree lose their stake. Honest bonds stay returnable, so the attack is priced far above honest joining.
